hook_tournament.why: [0] hits you instantly with a complete, shocking claim—'RUNNING ENTIRE BUSINESSES'—that's wild enough to stop your scroll, while [2] undermines the same story by framing it as 'WAYS,' which makes it sound like tips to try rather than a reality already proven.

GROK BOT IS RUNNING ENTIRE BUSINESSES. HERE ARE 7.
hook_sharpen.why: [1] hooks with 'HERE ARE 7'—promising real examples to see—while [0] sounds like a sales pitch with its price tag, triggering skepticism instead of curiosity. You swipe to verify a claim, not to be sold.
